title: Stochastic Gradient Leimkuhler—Matthews Integrator with Second Order Discretization Error
summary: Stochastic gradient Langevin dynamics (SGLD) has a discretization error of first order in the step size, even with the full gradient. We study the stochastic gradient Leimkuhler--Matthews (SGLM) integrator, which has the cost of SGLD and reuses each Gaussian vector in consecutive steps; its full-gradient form, the Leimkuhler--Matthews (LM) integrator, has a discretization error of second order for the invariant distribution. For a potential strongly convex outside a ball, we prove the bound $mathcal O(frac{1}{Nh} + Sigma^2 h^2 + h^4)$ on the mean square error (MSE) of time averages of SGLM…

review.reason: Analyzes the error and convergence of a stochastic gradient Leimkuhler–Matthews integrator.
